entries.6f3098d0f0396195: While the core LP gas cylinder valve market is trending toward contraction, the company says it will focus on developing and expanding sales of new product groups such as LNG valves, hydrogen valves, sanitary valves for food processing and general-purpose piping valves, and will strengthen its profit structure through productivity improvements and cost reduction. As the second pillar of growth, it is strengthening and expanding its low-temperature valve business for LNG, hydrogen, nitrogen and other industrial gases, and in September 2025 it established a joint venture with Shōei Kikō Co., Ltd. for product development. It positions the food processing field as its third pillar and is advancing efforts in watering nozzles and related products, sanitary valves and wine-making equipment.
